scripts.text: Weddings are performed by our local Priest with the intent of promoting love and peace among the loving couples.

scripts.text: The two who have been joined by marriage must remain together forever until the day death do them apart.

scripts.text: Although normally only males can wed females (and vice versa), our local Priest is more open-minded than that and he permits all pairings regardless of gender.

scripts.translation: 希望你們能解決問題。

scripts.text: Well, I can't file your divorce because you don't have enough for the fee. Get your partner to lend you some?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你的錢不夠支付手續費，無法辦理離婚。要不要向伴侶借一些？

scripts.text: Where has {0} gone to? I can't divorce you unless you both are here...
scripts.translation: {0}去哪兒了？你們兩人都在場，我才能為你們辦理離婚...

scripts.text: Your divorce has been filed. You are no longer wed.
scripts.translation: 離婚手續已辦理完成。你們現在已不再是夫妻。
